options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Game Difficulty
options.doc: Determines expected player skill. A harder difficulty means you will be expected to go further in the game with less resources.

options.name: Goal
options.doc: Determines the win condition for the game. Myzand 2: Traverse Myzand's Forest, defeat him, and lock him away. Eye Chest: Open the 6-Eye Door and collect the Eye Fragment.

options.name: Shuffle Slide Puzzles
options.doc: When enabled, slide puzzles and their rewards will be shuffled into the pool.

options.name: I Hate Seedling
options.doc: When enabled, Blue in Lost Swamp will always give you a gun, and you will always find a spell at the Fireball location. (This may break gun/spell plando, so be warned.)

options.name: Shuffle Bug-Eating Effects
options.doc: Randomizes the temporary effect gained when eating any bug other than Mushroom.

options.name: Shuffle Workshop Key
options.doc: When enabled, the Workshop Key will be shuffled into the item pool, and Bins will give you a random item after defeating Xoto.

options.name: Shop Multiplier
options.doc: Decreases the total cost of items in shops by a percentage. 100 = no discount, 0 = free shops. This does not impact gun upgrade costs, or buying from Supa.
options.doc_fr: Diminue le coût total des articles dans les magasins d'un pourcentage. 100 = pas de réduction, 0 = magasins gratuits. Cela n'a pas d'incidence sur les coûts de mise à niveau des armes, ni d'achat chez Supa.

options.name: Open City
options.doc: When enabled, the Lost Swamp portal vine will be enabled from the beginning, allowing quick travel to City without needing to traverse through most of the early game first.

options.name: Hardcore Parkour
options.doc: When enabled, the player will be expected to do more advanced or unituitive platform movement to get to some locations.

options.name: Well Light Logic
options.doc: Chooses which items will be expected to be acquired for traversing the well. Glowbug for navigating dark passages, Fire Fruit Juicer for relighting the candle after Fire-Eaters, or both.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez les articles qui devraient être acquis pour traverser le puits. Glowbug pour la navigation des passages sombres, Juicère de fruits de feu pour allumer la bougie après Fire-Eaters, ou les deux.
